items.reason: Input.OracleText byte-identical to real Gang of Devils; no IUnparsed/UnstructuredEffect; dealDamage total 3 with Divided:true + AnyTarget UpTo(Min1,Max3) + Dies/IsSelf trigger correctly models 'deals 3 damage divided among one, two, or three targets'
Sound shared generalization: nullable Divided facet records division-mode only (total split, not multiplied); both cited rules exist and their text matches the modeling

Doc-comment cites 'CR 113.8b' for 'it = the self-source pronoun (the permanent whose trigger fired)', but 113.8 governs the ability's CONTROLLER and has no subrules (113.8b absent from data); the rule that actually grounds 'the object whose ability triggered' is CR 113.7 (source). Wrong-rule + absent-subrule citation. The other three citations (115.7f, 601.2d, 115.4) and the modeling itself are correct.

Initiative-03 projection: Divided is a boolean FACET on the pre-existing dealDamage effectType, not a new PortWalk dispatch discriminator; dealDamage already has a semantic projection (emit:damage:<combat>:<recipient>, damage-flow arm) that the divided case rides. Division-among-N-targets is a quantity/targeting nuance no flow rule reads as a distinct edge, so no new PortGraph case / coarse entry is warranted. Sensible.
